trello.desc: Finalize the speaker lineup by sending follow-ups to the two maybes with a decision deadline of Friday. Use the backup list to fill any empty slots. Have the lineup locked in two weeks for agenda printing. Assigned to Bo.

trello.desc: Once the speaker lineup is locked, hand off bios and headshots to Diego for immediate landing page update. Ensure this is done the same day the lineup is locked. Assigned to Bo.
